faq.q: What does it cost to be listed?
faq.a: Listing is free. After applying, we run a Brand Voice Interview to determine fit. Optional marketing services are discussed only if it makes sense for your situation.
One listed professional per category, per metro. When a buyer searches, your profile is the answer — not one of ten.
CPAs, attorneys, fractional CFOs, business coaches, M&A advisors, exit-planning specialists, marketing agencies, and other vetted professionals serving the business community.
Visitors arrive via the parent directory's organic SEO and editorial content — buyer-intent searches by category and metro.
A 15-minute intro call to confirm fit, then the Brand Voice Interview. Listings typically go live within two weeks.
